doc.name: maxworth-public
doc.instructions: MaxWorth is a privacy-first credit card benefits tracker: recurring credits, annual-fee ROI, card-linked offers and cashback portal rates — without connecting a bank account. Use these tools to answer questions about specific credit cards (US, Canada, Australia), their statement credits and reset dates, cashback portal rates for a store, live Amex and Chase card-linked offers (which cards they have been seen on), and MaxWorth's Credit Deadline Report. search + fetch cover every public page (card pages, credit pages, articles) for open-ended questions. Every result carries a maxworth.app URL; cite it. Data is hand-verified against issuer terms and refreshed continuously; see https://maxworth.app/methodology/.

tools.name: search_cards
tools.title: Search credit cards
tools.description: Find credit cards in the MaxWorth catalogue by name or issuer (US, Canada, Australia). Returns name, issuer, annual fee and the canonical page URL to cite.

query.description: Card name or part of it, e.g. "sapphire reserve", "amex gold", "aeroplan"

country.description: Restrict to one market: us, ca (Canada) or au (Australia).

tools.name: get_card
tools.title: Get a card: fee, earn rates, every benefit
tools.description: Full record for one card from the MaxWorth database: annual fee, welcome offer, earning rates with true cash-back value, and every catalogued benefit with its value, cycle, reset rule and enrollment requirement. Hand-verified against the issuer; cite the page URL.

card.description: Card name or website slug, e.g. "Amex Platinum" or "chase-sapphire-reserve"

country.description: Restrict to one market: us, ca (Canada) or au (Australia).

tools.name: list_credits
tools.title: List a card's statement credits with reset dates
tools.description: Only the dollar credits on a card: value per year, per-cycle cap, cycle, whether an annual credit resets January 1 or on the card anniversary, and enrollment. Use for "when does the X credit reset" questions.

country.description: Restrict to one market: us, ca (Canada) or au (Australia).

tools.name: compare_cards
tools.title: Compare two or three cards
tools.description: Side by side: annual fee, number and face value of statement credits, deadlines per year, top earning categories. Cite the card pages.

country.description: Restrict to one market: us, ca (Canada) or au (Australia).

tools.name: search_cashback_portals
tools.title: Cashback portal rates for a store
tools.description: Current shopping-portal cashback / miles / points rates for an online store (Rakuten, TopCashback, airline and bank malls), checked daily by MaxWorth. Returns each portal's rate and the comparison page URL.

limit.description: How many matching stores to return

tools.name: search_card_offers
tools.title: Live Amex / Chase card-linked offers
tools.description: Card-linked merchant offers (Amex Offers, Chase Offers) that are live today, as seen by MaxWorth browser-extension users: merchant, the deal, fine print, latest expiry seen, and which cards it has appeared on. Filter by issuer, merchant, card, expiry window or popularity; with no filters it returns an overview. Offers are targeted per account: a card listed means several users saw the offer on that card, not that every cardholder has it.

card.description: List offers seen on one card, e.g. "Chase Sapphire Preferred" or "Amex Gold"

expiring_within_days.description: Only offers whose latest seen expiry is within this many days

popular_only.description: Only offers MaxWorth flags as popular

tools.name: credit_deadline_report
tools.title: Credit Deadline Report 2026 (MaxWorth data)
tools.description: Headline figures from MaxWorth's open data report on what US cardholders track: cards and fees per user, recurring credits and deadlines per year, most-skipped credits, logged-use index. Percentages and medians only, CC BY 4.0. Cite the report URL.

tools.name: about_maxworth
tools.title: What MaxWorth is
tools.description: The canonical description of MaxWorth, its platforms, pricing and where its data comes from.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search MaxWorth
tools.description: Search every public MaxWorth page: credit card pages (US, Canada, Australia), one page per statement credit, and all guides, reviews and news articles. Returns ids to pass to fetch. Use for open-ended questions; the dedicated tools (get_card, list_credits, search_cashback_portals, search_card_offers) answer structured questions faster.

query.description: Search query, e.g. "Amex Platinum hotel credit" or "best credit card tracker apps"

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Fetch a MaxWorth page
tools.description: Full text of one MaxWorth page by the id returned from search (a site path such as /cards/chase-sapphire-reserve), or by its maxworth.app URL. Returns the page as Markdown with its canonical URL for citation.

id.description: Document id from search, or a maxworth.app URL
